purpose: Persist canonical verified execution evidence before entitlement/receipt/response/revenue finalization.
sensitive_material: No payment credentials, private keys, authorization signatures, or secrets are persisted by this field.
backward_compatibility: Records without durableResult remain readable and are not inferred as verified.
rollback: Revert the additive gate change; existing records remain readable.
terminology: durable staged-finalization protocol, not distributed two-phase commit
